title: Detailed glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glasses: a single pair of detailed spectacles, lit for Doot's screen -->
  <!-- left lens -->
  <rect x='8' y='38' width='36' height='28' rx='9' fill='#7FD4FF' stroke='none'/>
  <rect x='10' y='40' width='32' height='24' rx='8' fill='#CFF2FF'/>
  <!-- left lens shine -->
  <path d='M16 44 Q20 42 24 44 L22 52 Q18 50 16 50 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- right lens -->
  <rect x='56' y='38' width='36' height='28' rx='9' fill='#7FD4FF' stroke='none'/>
  <rect x='58' y='40' width='32' height='24' rx='8' fill='#CFF2FF'/>
  <!-- right lens shine -->
  <path d='M82 44 Q86 42 90 44 L88 52 Q84 50 82 50 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- bridge between lenses -->
  <rect x='42' y='46' width='16' height='7' rx='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='43' y='47' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#FFF0B8'/>
  <!-- left temple arm -->
  <rect x='2' y='44' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FF9E5E'/>
  <rect x='3' y='45' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD3B0'/>
  <!-- right temple arm -->
  <rect x='88' y='44' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FF9E5E'/>
  <rect x='89' y='45' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD3B0'/>
  <!-- nose pads -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#FF6FB5'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#FF6FB5'/>
  <!-- frame rim highlights (inner edges, different shade) -->
  <path d='M14 62 Q26 66 38 62' stroke='#4DA8DE' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 62 Q74 66 86 62' stroke='#4DA8DE' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
